text: From what I understand, moving can cause problems if you are moving very close the time of a renewal appointment or expected status upgrade. After the Israeli registers their new address, it takes time (maybe a couple of months) for PIBA to transfer the file to the new office. This can cause delays if you have any appointments coming up very soon. Otherwise it shouldn't be a major problem. (Note there are less likely to be problems for those on A5 and more than halfway through the process - often PIBA will just opt to keep your file with your original office).
